edit.description: gate union: blockedBy.tag -> blockedBy.tags (non-empty array; empty is a parse error). Update the doc-comment line, the prompt-schema hint, and isPickableNow's blockedBy case (pickable iff every tag shipped).
wave auto-unblock rewrite: drop landed tags from the list, flip to open only once empty. The dispatcher-local pickability copy (same switch shape) gets the identical change.
schema + isPickableNow coverage for the list form.
auto-unblock partial-drain and pickability coverage.

summary: gate.blockedBy.tag (singular) -> gate.blockedBy.tags (non-empty list); empty list is a parse error, not an open gate.
tests: empty blockedBy.tags array is a schema parse error
entry pickable only when every named blocker tag has shipped
wave auto-unblock removes landed tags from the list and flips to open only once empty
an entry naming an unshipped blocker among several stays blockedBy with the shorter list
acceptance: PendingSchema and Dispatcher agree on gate.blockedBy.tags; a multi-parent DAG entry no longer flattens to a single blocker.
notes: Two read sites carry the same switch (PendingSchema.ts isPickableNow, Dispatcher.ts's local copy) — both must change identically. Also governed by spec/pending.md Pickability and Wave auto-unblock.

edit.description: TickResult: add quarantinedTags?: readonly string[] and nothingPickable?: boolean.
fanout selection: when FLUME_QUARANTINED_SLUGS drops a tag from the pickable set, record it on the result; set nothingPickable when nothing remains after the drop.
coverage for both fields across quarantined/non-quarantined nothing-pickable ticks.

summary: TickResult.quarantinedTags + nothingPickable so a chain's handoff can tell a quarantined open entry from a genuinely pickable one.
tests: a fanout tick with every open entry quarantined reports nothingPickable:true and the dropped tags on quarantinedTags
quarantinedTags is empty (not absent) on a nothing-pickable tick with no quarantine
both fields are absent on a tick that provisioned an entry
acceptance: A chain reading TickResult distinguishes a quarantined open entry from a pickable one without re-deriving it from pendingAfter.
notes: Fixes the reproduced live-lock: a consumer's build handoff re-woke on a quarantined open entry and burned ticks to --max. Also spec'd at spec/pending.md Pickability (selection-drop reporting).

edit.description: Chain.supervisorPolicy: add partitionIgnore?: string[].
PartitionOptions gains the ignore-globs list; partitionByFileOverlap treats a path matching matchesAny(path, ignore) as touched by nobody.
runFanout reads supervisorPolicy.partitionIgnore ?? [] per tick and passes it to the partition call; the observedFiles footprint recorder filters the same paths through the same list.
ignored-path collision-avoidance coverage.
per-tick read of partitionIgnore off the resolved chain.

summary: supervisorPolicy.partitionIgnore narrows the fanout partition's collision set only; write guard and ship detection are unaffected.
tests: two entries touching only an ignored path partition into the same wave
an entry touching both an ignored and a non-ignored shared path still collides on the non-ignored path
declaredPaths / write guard / ship detection are unaffected by partitionIgnore
acceptance: A chain declaring partitionIgnore widens wave width for entries colliding only on the ignored path; default [] is byte-identical to today.
notes: Read per tick off the resolved chain, same shape as maxParallel/tickTimeoutMs (spec/chain.md Supervisor policy is a chain-overridable default).

edit.description: Gate: add command?: string.

shellGate renders command as one line from cmd+args — the single site behind tscGate/vitestGate/eslintGate/pkgManagerGate. chainLoadGate/pendingGate/writablePathsGate declare none (hand-rolled, no single command line).
prependHarnessBlock's gate line renders ': <command>' when the gate declares one, else unchanged.
type/passthrough coverage.
shellGate command rendering; hand-rolled gates carry none.
harness block render with and without a declared command.

summary: shellGate-built gates declare Gate.command; the harness block shows it beside the gate name so a chain's prompt doesn't restate it.
tests: shellGate's returned Gate.command renders cmd+args as one line
a hand-rolled gate has no command and renders as name alone
harness block shows 'name (when): <command>' when command is present, 'name (when)' otherwise
acceptance: An agent reading <harness> sees the exact command a shellGate-built gate will run, sourced from the gate's own declaration.
notes: Render side also spec'd at spec/prompt.md The harness block.

edit.description: GateResult: add failingFiles?: string[].
GateRevertAttempt: add suspectFlake?: boolean.
at the gate-revert prior-attempt write site, derive suspectFlake when the gate result's failingFiles is present and every entry is disjoint from the reverted span's footprint.
type coverage.
disjoint vs overlapping failingFiles, and the absent-field case.

summary: GateResult.failingFiles lets Dispatcher derive suspectFlake on a gate-revert record from list disjointness, never from gate prose.
tests: a gate-revert record whose failingFiles is disjoint from the reverted span's footprint is marked suspectFlake:true
a gate-revert record whose failingFiles overlaps the footprint earns no marker
a gate result with no failingFiles earns no marker (today's behavior)
acceptance: suspectFlake is present only when both lists are present and provably disjoint; an absent field is never inferred as flaky.
notes: Also spec'd at spec/loop.md Prior-outcome feedback to the retrying tick. No builtin gate is required to populate failingFiles by this entry — none currently can report it.

edit.description: cherryPickAbort: guard the --abort call on sequencer state (CHERRY_PICK_HEAD or sequencer/ present) — never blind.
before a primary-checkout pick range begins, checkpoint any staged bystander state as a dangling commit (git stash create shape) and record its sha on the tick verdict.
no-op abort when no sequence started; --abort issued when sequencer state is present.
checkpoint sha recorded and staged content recoverable from it after an abort/reset.

summary: Primary-checkout cherry-pick --abort only fires against a sequence that started; staged bystander state is checkpointed to a recoverable sha first.
tests: cherryPickAbort issues no git command when no sequencer state is present
cherryPickAbort issues --abort when CHERRY_PICK_HEAD/sequencer state is present
staged bystander content present when a pick range begins is recoverable via the sha recorded on the tick verdict
acceptance: A pick failing before a sequence starts never touches bystander index/working-tree state; staged bystander content always has a recorded recovery sha.
notes: Ratified 2026-08-18 (271fb13), sequenced to the 0.13 line now that 0.12.0 shipped. The checkpoint-sha field name on TickVerdict is build's call.

edit.description: harvestFriction: bound moves from base-commit-relative (readFileAtRef against baseRef) to untracked-at-worktree-HEAD, so a note this tick's own agent committed is delivered once, not duplicated under a stamped name.
a committed friction note is harvested zero times; the existing new-since-base case stays covered.

summary: Teardown harvest moves files untracked at the worktree's HEAD, not merely new since base — a committed note is delivered once, via its own commit.
tests: a friction-channel file the tick's agent committed is not harvested a second time under a stamped name
a file untracked at worktree HEAD but absent from the base tree is still harvested
a file the checkout itself brought in (tracked at both base and HEAD) is never harvested
acceptance: Harvest count for a wave where the agent committed its own friction note matches one delivery, not two.
notes: Fixes the field-reported duplication (one committed note became eight stamped copies across two waves).

edit.description: TickVerdict: add headSha: string, at: string (ISO timestamp), populated by writeTickVerdict. Add readLatestVerdictsSync(flumeDir): most-recent verdict per phaseName, synchronous, reading the same verdict log readTickVerdicts does.
export readLatestVerdictsSync.
export readLatestVerdictsSync.
headSha/at correctness; readLatestVerdictsSync per-phase latest reduction.

summary: Every TickVerdict carries headSha/at; readLatestVerdictsSync gives shouldRun/handoff a synchronous per-phase anchor read.

per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

tests: a written verdict's headSha matches the trunk tip and at is a valid ISO timestamp
readLatestVerdictsSync returns the most recent verdict per phase name from the verdict log
headSha/at are written on a quiet (no-commit) tick too, not only a committed one
acceptance: A chain compares a verdict's headSha to the live tip without inferring it from touched paths, and reads it from shouldRun/handoff without await.
notes: readTickVerdicts stays async; readLatestVerdictsSync is the new sync sibling for the two synchronous chain hooks.

edit.description: AgentResult gains per-invocation usage: model id, turn count, duration, and token counts (input/output/cacheCreation/cacheRead), parsed from the same stream-json result event withTerminalRenderer's formatResult already reads — one source, not a second parser.
TickVerdict: add invocations[] — one row per agent run this tick (tag present for a fanout entry, absent for a singleton), populated from each AgentResult.
usage extraction from a result event, including a field the agent didn't report.
singleton vs fanout invocations[] shape.

summary: TickVerdict.invocations[] carries one usage row per agent run (model, turns, duration, token counts incl. cache split); absent fields the agent didn't report.

per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

tests: a singleton tick's verdict carries one invocations[] row with no tag
a fanout tick's verdict carries one invocations[] row per provisioned entry, each tagged
a field the agent's result didn't report is absent on the row, not zero
acceptance: Cost/telemetry for a tick is readable from the verdict alone, without re-parsing the agent's stdout stream in a decorator.
notes: Collides with verdict-anchor-head-sha-at on TickVerdict/Dispatcher.ts — expected, both edit the same type.

export slugify, priorAttemptPath.
export slugify, priorAttemptPath.

render coverage carrying the two new fields through the five variants.

per.section: Prior-outcome feedback to the retrying tick

tests: priorAttemptPath(flumeDir, tag) matches the path the dispatcher itself reads/writes for that tag
every one of the 5 prior-attempt record variants carries headSha and at when written
a chain's shouldRun can compare a stale record's headSha to the live tip instead of the file's mtime

notes: Export is also spec'd at spec/pending.md What the package exports. Collides with gate-failing-files-suspect-flake on Prompt.ts's GateRevertAttempt — expected.
